name: canimcp quirks corpus
note: Client-version-scoped MCP quirks distilled from published reproductions. evidence: measured = run under a harness against pinned client binaries; probe = direct binary probe, a lead until measured; historical = cleared at tested versions, still worth knowing for pinned/older clients.

sources.note: SineFrame Harness Quirks Matrix, 2026-10-09. 10 features x Claude Code 2.1.287 x Codex 0.162.0, 3 trials/cell.
Direct probes of Claude Code 2.1.295 and Codex 0.162.0 binaries, same article. Not yet measured under the harness.
r/mcp reports: a tool silently dropped for 17 days over a root oneOf; tool-name length/charset truncation; clients missing tools with no error either side.

rules.title: argument name containing [ ]
rules.message: Claude Code never calls a tool whose input property is named like "ids[]" - the tool is silently absent from its list (0/3 runs). OpenAPI-generated servers often emit these names.
rules.fix: rename the property to a bare identifier, e.g. "ids" or "id_list"

rules.title: root oneOf/anyOf next to properties
rules.message: A root oneOf or anyOf placed next to "properties" made Codex lose the property names - the call reached the server with mangled arguments. r/mcp reports a production tool silently dropped 17 days over a root oneOf.
rules.fix: move the composition inside each property, or wrap the object so "properties" is not a sibling of oneOf/anyOf

rules.title: tool inputSchema with no root type
rules.message: One tool whose inputSchema has no root "type" made Claude Code drop the entire server's tool list.

rules.title: more than 2048 tools on one server
rules.message: With 2049 tools on one server, Codex silently dropped every tool past the 2048th.
rules.fix: split the server, or gate rare tools behind a meta/discovery tool

rules.title: inputSchema over ~14 KB
rules.message: Codex compacts large input schemas to fit a per-server budget (~20 KB). A 14 KB schema lost its required nested fields and calls arrived incomplete (0/3).
rules.fix: shrink the schema (shared $defs help), or raise Codex's per-server schema budget to 20000 if you control the client

rules.title: enum inside anyOf/oneOf in a >5 KB schema
rules.message: An enum nested inside anyOf in a schema over 5 KB had the enum erased by Codex's schema compaction - the model no longer saw the allowed values.
rules.fix: hoist the enum to the property root, or shrink the schema under ~5 KB

rules.title: prefixItems tuple in inputSchema
rules.message: A prefixItems tuple was declared to the model as Array<string> - the per-position types were erased.
rules.fix: model the arguments as an object with named properties instead of a positional tuple

rules.title: integer argument that can exceed 2^53
rules.message: int64 value 1234567890123456789 arrived rounded on Claude Code, and string-or-rounded on Codex.
rules.fix: accept big integers as strings and parse on the server

rules.title: tool names that collide when normalized
rules.message: fetch.page and fetch_page on the same server: one was misrouted by Claude Code.
rules.fix: keep tool names distinct after removing non-alphanumeric characters

rules.title: outputSchema declared - result shape matters
rules.message: When a result carried both content text and structuredContent, Claude Code surfaced only the structured value; when a tool declared outputSchema but returned text only, a success was surfaced as an error.
rules.fix: if you declare outputSchema, always return structuredContent; repeat anything critical in the text content too

rules.title: tool name over 64 chars or non-ASCII charset
rules.message: Some clients have silently truncated or rejected long/unusual tool names. A 65-char name worked on Claude Code 2.1.287 and Codex 0.162.0, but older or enterprise-pinned clients may still drop it.

advisories.message: After a server's tool list changed, Codex kept using its old catalog and never called the new tool (0/3).
advisories.fix: restart the client session after deploying new tools

advisories.message: Claude Code keeps roughly the first and last 5000 characters of a tool error - a marker in the middle of a 12000-char error never reached the model.
advisories.fix: put code, reason and next step at the start of error messages

advisories.message: With gpt-5.6-sol, Codex runs in code mode: the model never sees your JSON Schema, only a compacted TypeScript declaration generated from it - several Codex failures happen in that translation.
advisories.fix: assume the client sees a lossy projection of your schema, not the schema itself
